scripts.preaab: npm run bump:patch && npm run bump:android:versionCode && npm run sync:app-update-manifest
scripts.test:smoke: npm run audit:i18n && npm run simulate:google-auto-connect && npm run simulate:google-backup && npm run simulate:bank-sync && npm run simulate:first-bank-provider
scripts.check: npm run test:node && npm run build:web
scripts.debug: npm run sync:app-update-manifest && VITE_FORCE_MEMBER_ON_DEBUG=true npx vite build --mode debug && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cd ..
scripts.build: npm run sync:app-update-manifest && vite build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && cd ..
scripts.aab: npm run sync:app-update-manifest && npx vite build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease && cd ..
scripts.assets:generate: mkdir -p resources && cp src/ui/assets/logo-icon.png resources/icon.png && cp src/ui/assets/logo-icon.png resources/splash.png && npx @capacitor/assets generate resources
